    How to upgrade/downgrade Rubygems:¶ ↑

    Downgrade Recipe¶ ↑

    $ gem update --system 3.1.4

    Upgrade Recipe¶ ↑

    $ gem update --system

    Install from source¶ ↑

    • Download from: rubygems.org/pages/download

    • Unpack into a directory and cd there

    • Install with: ruby setup.rb
